'''Viral''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the SRP Mod. This Effect makes you take additional damage. Being affected with Viral increases damage received by 50% * Amplifier.  This means Viral I gives a 1.5x damage multiplier while Viral V gives a 3.5x damage multiplier. It also adds a screen effect.<!--Multiplier (0.5) x Amplifier x Damage += Damage-->

Viral cannot be removed by drinking Milk.
